name: Firebase Auth
subtitle: Google's managed auth service
creator: Firebase (founded 2011, joined Google 2014)
description: Drop-in authentication for web and mobile: email and password, phone, anonymous and social providers. The Identity Platform upgrade adds MFA, SAML and OIDC, multi-tenancy and blocking functions. Its ID tokens are read by Firestore and Storage Security Rules through request.auth.
useCases: Mobile apps on iOS, Android and Flutter

languages.written: SDKs in JS/TS, Swift, Kotlin, Dart and C++
languages.youWrite: JavaScript or TypeScript, or a mobile language

concepts.explanation: Google, Apple, GitHub, email, phone and more.
Upgrade anonymous users to permanent accounts.

codeSamples.label: JavaScript

pros: Very easy setup, especially on mobile
Deep integration with Firebase and Google Cloud
cons: Google lock-in; exporting users takes work
Enterprise features need the Identity Platform upgrade

pricing.summary: With Identity Platform: first 50,000 MAU free, then from $0.0055 per MAU. SAML and OIDC: 50 MAU free. First 10 SMS per day free.
